propositions: Live DC harness renders a rich-text body (heading/bold/code macro) via rebar.edit_ticket and asserts rendered HTML through ?expand=renderedFields contains expected markup (h1/b/pre tags).
A second reconcile pass after live rendering computes zero inbound mutations (echo-safety: the landed wiki body decodes to an unchanged value, no re-push).

With a converged baseline, a both-sides concurrent edit (rebar description + Jira description) before the next pass keeps rebar's body (local-wins) and emits a deduped outbound-field-conflict alert (remote value recorded, not clobbered).

The inbound differ now injects the outbound mapper and treats Jira's description as unchanged when it equals the local body's landed wire form, closing the echo-safety gap between codec-aware outbound and ADF-only inbound.
A cross-repo contract test pins InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text signature and behavior to prevent breaking changes in agentic-dev-platform imports.
